title: fix(lint): walk page filterBy and lookup-field lookupFilters as authored filters
body:
Fixes #19791
Clause-②: no

## Defect

`FILTER_KEYS` in `packages/lint/src/filter-walk.ts` held `filter`, `filters`, `runtimeFilter` and `relatedListFilter`. The walk never entered two consumed filter carriers: a list page's `interfaceConfig.filterBy` (`z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)`) and a lookup field's `lookupFilters`. I reproduced it on `a5afe382ba` with the card's rule `{ field: 'close_date', operator: 'gt', value: 'last_30_days' }`:

| carrier | schema | `validatePresetComparands` | runtime publish gate |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| page `interfaceConfig.filterBy` | GREEN (`PageSchema`) | 0 findings | `page` write: 0 errors |
| lookup field `lookupFilters` | GREEN (`FieldSchema`) | 0 findings | `object` write: 0 errors |
| lit control: component `dataSource.filter` | GREEN | REFUSED | `page` write: REFUSED |

- **Dark control:** an ISO `2026-01-15` value is green in every cell, before and after.
- **Parse control:** a `{ $x: 1 }` value in `filterBy` is refused by `PageSchema` at `interfaceConfig.filterBy.0.value`, so the slot is parsed.

**Both carriers are consumed.** Readings are from objectui at `.objectui-sha` `87af769e9a`. `InterfaceListPage.tsx` spreads `cfg.filterBy` into the list view's `filter`. `lookupFiltersToRecord` (`RecordPickerDialog.tsx`) lowers each lookup entry to a Mongo operator (`gt` becomes `$gt`) on the referenced object. Both values reach ObjectQL's `where` verbatim.

## Design: widen the shared key set, measured per rule

`FILTER_KEYS` feeds four rules. For each rule, this is what reaching the two carriers does:

| rule | reaching `filterBy` / `lookupFilters` | measured |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `filter-preset-comparand` | Right. Both carriers are `{ field, operator, value }` rules, which `judgeFilterRule` already judges. `normalizeFilterOperator` folds all nine lookup operators (`eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`, `contains`, `in`, `notIn`). | New findings on both carriers (pinned) |
| `filter-token-unknown` | Right. The engine resolves the same two vocabularies in `where` (`resolveFilterTokens`, `engine.ts`). It throws `FILTER_TOKEN_UNKNOWN` on the same `classifyFilterToken` verdict this rule reports. Neither carrier resolves tokens client-side: 0 `resolveFilterPlaceholders` hits in `InterfaceListPage.tsx`, `plugin-list/src` and `fields/src`. Lit control: `ObjectView.tsx` has a hit. | `{current_user}` is found on both carriers. `{current_user_id}` and `{30_days_ago}` stay clean (pinned). |
| `filter-empty-combinator` / `filter-empty-node` | No-op. Both carriers are arrays, and the rule judges Mongo-shape nodes only. Its header scopes out the array shape. | `filterBy: []` and `lookupFilters: []` give 0 findings |
| `flow-filter-token-unknown` | No-op. The rule walks `flows` only, and no schema under `packages/spec/src/automation` declares either key. | 0 findings |

**Corpus, base vs head.** Base is merge-base `502f179cc`. Head is this branch.

- `app-showcase` (24 objects, 28 pages, 30 flows) carries 2 `filterBy` and 1 `lookupFilters`. All four rules report 0 findings on base and 0 on head.
- Lit control on the same corpus: the first rule of each of the 3 real carriers is rewritten in memory to the card's preset. Base reports 0 findings on the carriers. Head reports 3.
- `app-crm` and `app-todo` carry neither key. All four rules report 0 on both base and head.
- `app-multi-package` was not measured: loading it from its own directory resolved a different `@objectstack/spec` build. `git grep` finds no carrier in it.

**Why the shared set and not a rule-local key table.** A local table would behave identically today, because the other two rules are no-ops. But it would record a platform fact ("these keys hold a consumed filter") once per rule, so the next walking rule would start with the hole. The shared set is the choice `relatedListFilter` already made. The file header records the reason: to extend every walking rule "instead of leaving a per-rule hole".

**Binding (preset rule only).** The field-typed arm needs the object a condition addresses, so two readers are added:

- **`filterBy`** binds to `interfaceConfig.source`. The reader applies only at the page's own `interfaceConfig`. Without a `source`, it falls through to the page's `object`, the same fallback `validate-page-field-bindings` uses.
- **`lookupFilters`** binds to the enclosing field's `reference`, and to nothing when there is none. It never binds to the owning object, because the picker queries the target object's fields (ADR-0057 records the same reading of `lookupFilters`). A `relatedListFilter` on the same field still binds to the owner.

## What changes for authors

- `os lint`, `os validate` and the runtime publish gate (`page` and `object` writes) now refuse a date-range preset in these rules:
  - ordering rules in either carrier (`gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, and `between` in `filterBy`);
  - equality or membership rules on a `date` / `datetime` field.
- An unresolvable placeholder in either carrier is now refused by `os lint` / `os validate`. `filter-token-unknown` is CLI-only.
- The fix: replace the preset with the `{date-macro}` window the message names, or with an ISO date.

## Tests and ablation

- **New tests:** 5 in `validate-preset-comparands.test.ts` and 1 in `validate-filter-tokens.test.ts`. They cover:
  - arm 1 on both carriers, with map-form and array-form `fields`;
  - arm 2 bound through `source` and through `reference`;
  - both wrong-object controls;
  - `relatedListFilter` binding to the owner on the same field;
  - a no-finding pin for legal comparands on both carriers.
- **Red on base source.** Restoring both `src` files to `a5afe382ba` (blob hashes checked) gives 5 failed and 33 passed. Head gives 38 passed.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven blob == HEAD):
  - Dropping the two keys gives 5 failed.
  - Removing the `lookupFilters` claim gives 1 failed, and a probe then shows the false refusal: owner `close_date: date`, target `close_date: select`, `eq 'this_quarter'` is reported.
  - Removing the `interfaceConfig` reader gives 1 failed, and the mirror false refusal on `filterBy` appears.
  - My first attempt at the key ablation was refused by the tool's count check before any test ran.

## Verification

Measured at `e4010360be`: this branch with `origin/main` `502f179cc` merged in.

- `@objectstack/lint` test: base 108 files / 4121 tests passed; head 108 / 4127 passed (+6).
- `@objectstack/lint` typecheck: exit 0 on base and on head. Test-layer debt is unchanged at 2 files / 6 errors.
- `@objectstack/lint` build: exit 0 on base and on head.
- Runtime gate, head: `page` writes refuse `pages[0].interfaceConfig.filterBy[0].value`, and `object` writes refuse `objects.crm_invoice.fields.account.lookupFilters[0].value`, for both `gt` and `eq`. ISO values stay clean.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 59 families. 57 ran with exit 0. `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure` passed after building lint and objectql.
- Not measured (exit 3, prerequisite is a full-repo build): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt`. `--ran` reports 0 unrun.
- Hygiene: 0 control-byte lines and 0 model identifiers in the diff and commit messages (both greps checked against a lit control).
- No ADR-0087 entry is needed: the changeset is `patch`, has no breaking marker, and says `Clause-②: no`. `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` passes.
